counties.notes: Shawnee County KS (Topeka metro, county seat and state capital Topeka) provides AppraisalDataPro/MapServer/4 (Current Parcels) via the county appraiser's GIS server. This is a 20-field service: OBJECTID, PARCELNUM, ACRES, PID, QUICKREFID, ONAME (owner name), PADDRESS, PADDRESS2, DBOOKPAGE, SUBS (subdivision), NBHD (neighborhood), TAXUNIT, USD (unified school district), LBCSFUNCTION, LBCSACTIVITY, LDVAL, BLDGVAL, TOTVAL, Shape, Shape area. Query confirmed live: UPPER(ONAME) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real results (e.g., 'SMITH, NEIL K & JONI' on SE 105TH ST). The same service has layer 0 (Parcel Information with Labels), layer 3 (Parcels 1-1-2024, prior year snapshot), and layer 4 (Current Parcels). The Shawnee County Open Data Portal at data-sncoks-gis.opendata.arcgis.com provides additional datasets. The property search app is at gis.sncoapps.us/propertysearch/. Shawnee County KS (FIPS 20177) must not be confused with Shawnee County Ohio or Shawnee Township. NOTE 2026-06-27: query endpoint responds in 13-35s (server-side slowness. Returns 437,436 features when polled with 35s timeout); liveness check at 12s flags FAIL but endpoint IS live. Metadata returns immediately.
